paragraphs.text: Zulaport is a coastal city on the island of Beyeen , part of Ondu on the plane of Zendikar .

Before the rise of the Eldrazi , Zulaport was a modest but bustling port city on Beyeen’s coast, inhabited by a transient community of mages , explorers , and artisans of many races and origins. Its thriving economy was controlled by the powerful vampire Indorel , who maintained her grip through a network of goblin , human , and ogre thugs. Under Indorel’s influence, all trade passing through Beyeen paid her tribute.

When the Eldrazi awoke, devastation struck the city in the form of a massive tsunami that swallowed much of Zulaport. In the aftermath, merfolk from nearby communities helped rebuild Zulaport as a floating settlement anchored along Beyeen’s rugged coastline. Today, Zulaport survives as a vital outpost for traders and a resupply station for expeditions across the Bay of Beyeen and the Silundi Sea . Although Indorel still lurks in the shadows of Zulaport’s floating docks, her stranglehold on its commerce has been broken.
